key_reasoning.reason: 3 files changed per diffstat (CredentialFields.tsx, its sharePointAuth test, settingsUIConfig.ts) spanning the SettingsForm component directory, its __tests__ subdirectory, and src/utils/ — small but not single-directory.

Change is confined to the shared CredentialFields renderer and the SharePoint entry in settingsUIConfig.ts (the credential config map it reads), both within the single existing SettingsForm UI feature — no new component or layer boundary introduced. CredentialFields.tsx now prefers an explicit config.label over the derived getLabel(placeholder) fallback, and the sharepoint field configs in settingsUIConfig.ts (url, tenant_id, client_id, client_secret) carry explicit labels so the Azure app registration fields render in a fixed URL / Tenant ID / Client ID / Secret order — an additive tweak to an existing, well-established rendering pattern.
